description: This Java class is a serializer component within the Apache Fineract project that transforms LoanTransactionBusinessEvent objects into an Avro data transfer object (LoanTransactionDataV1). It integrates with various services to retrieve loan transaction data, maps these data to Avro schema formats, and includes custom event serializers for extensibility.

classes.name: LoanTransactionBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A Spring component class that serializes LoanTransactionBusinessEvent objects into Avro format, incorporating loan transaction data retrieval, mapping, and custom data extension.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the given BusinessEvent is an instance of LoanTransactionBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a LoanTransactionBusinessEvent into an Avro schema object (LoanTransactionDataV1) by fetching required loan transaction data, mapping it, and attaching custom data.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the specific Avro schema class supported by this serializer: LoanTransactionDataV1.

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Provides the list of external serializers used for customizing event data serialization.
